note.note:
I don’t have the transcript or the DDx JSON — both are required to create the Problem List Clinical Note. Please paste the raw transcript and the DDx JSON into your next message (you may use the same delimiters shown in your instructions).

Helpful instructions for what to include:
- Full clinician–patient transcript (verbatim). If long, include all relevant sections (history, ROS, exam, plan).
- The DDx JSON output from your diagnostic reasoning model.
- Note any sections that should be redacted for privacy (names, MRN, etc.), or confirm I should keep PHI as-is.

Optional but useful:
- Flag any specific problems you want emphasized.
- Indicate if any medication doses/routes/frequencies are unknown (I’ll mark “dose/route/frequency not documented” when necessary).

Once you paste both the transcript and DDx, I will produce the Problem List Clinical Note in the exact format you specified.
